user-invocable: true

<!-- Generated by plugin-tools build-ports from commands/status.md. -->
Read `logic-fabric/.active` and every `logic-fabric/changes/*/status.yaml`. For the active change show: stage,
which gates are approved (and whether the approved files still match, as the context hook reports), tasks done and open in
`plan.md`, the last test run (`tests_*`), open findings by severity, and the next step. List the other changes with
their stage in one line each. Then offer to take the next step as a choice in your question tool, not a question in
your reply ("Offer the next step" in the authoring skill says how). Read only: change nothing unless the user picks
it.
